items.fullSentence: Je voudrais ce plat, s'il vous plaît.

whyWrong.cet: cet is for masculine nouns starting with a vowel; plat starts with a consonant.
whyWrong.cette: cette is feminine; plat is masculine.
whyWrong.ces: ces is plural; plat is singular.

items.fullSentence: On fait les courses cet après-midi.
items.sentenceTrans: We're doing the shopping this afternoon.

whyWrong.ce: après-midi starts with a vowel — ce becomes cet: cet après-midi.
whyWrong.ces: ces is plural — one afternoon: cet après-midi.

items.sentenceTrans: What are we eating this week?

whyWrong.ce: ce is masculine; semaine is feminine.
whyWrong.cet: cet is for masculine vowel-initial nouns; semaine is feminine.
whyWrong.ces: ces is plural; semaine is singular.

items.fullSentence: Ces légumes ont l'air très frais.

whyWrong.Ce: ce is masculine singular; légumes is plural.
whyWrong.Cet: cet is masculine singular; légumes is plural.
whyWrong.Cette: cette is feminine singular; légumes is plural.
